inputs.description: Source JSON files, target schema, and output path used for this merge operation.

sources.description: List of source JSON files used for merging.

alias.description: Logical name for the source file.

path.description: Filesystem path to the source JSON file.

target_schema.description: Schema ID of the JSON structure to be produced.

output_path.description: Filesystem path where the merged JSON file was written.

config.description: Mapping rules defining how fields are copied from source JSONs into the output JSON.

mappings.description: List of field mappings: source → destination.

from.description: JSONPath-like reference to a field in a source file.

source.description: Alias of the source JSON file.

to.description: JSONPath-like reference to the output location.

required.description: If true, missing field causes the merger to fail.

results.description: Execution results of the schema merger–splitter.

output_file.description: Path to the generated JSON file.

copied_fields.description: List of fields successfully copied into the output JSON.

missing_required_fields.description: List of required fields that were not found in the source JSONs.

validation_passed.description: Whether the output JSON matched the target schema.
